context: Schema directive transformers registered on the executable schema. Only a `@deprecated` directive exists so far.
explanation: Safe to merge. The new `authDirective` wraps any field marked `@auth(requires: ROLE)` so its resolver only runs after checking `context.currentUser` exists and has the required role, throwing AuthenticationError/ForbiddenError otherwise — a clean, reusable, schema-declared authorization mechanism instead of duplicating role checks inside every resolver.
